review_criteria: clear page hierarchy and one obvious primary action
readable type hierarchy and consistent spacing
secondary technical details accessible on demand
balanced empty, loading and filled states
no clipped text or page overflow at360/390/768/1440
preserve important keyboard focus and modal behavior
final_checks: old independent filter modal and account/table checks
password required on refresh and simulation default off
no service or original data source changes
publication: same existing GitHub Pages URL after independent final acceptance
visual_review_method: Compare baseline and revised viewport screenshots; inspect type, spacing, grouping, first-screen task visibility and mobile reachability. Full-page overflow alone does not count as design acceptance.
efficient_validation_policy: Use one central build after module freezes, one independent integrated screenshot/interaction run and targeted existing module regressions. Repeat only changed or failed cases; do not repeat paid model grounding for unchanged backend.
intermediate_width_reason: At1024px the fixed232px global sidebar and56px view padding leave736px content width; layouts must respond to content space instead of assuming full viewport width.

minimum_visual_acceptance.assistant_mobile: question field and primary send/search action visible on initial390px viewport
minimum_visual_acceptance.changes_desktop: result or meaningful empty state visible without traversing service metadata
minimum_visual_acceptance.evidence_mobile: source content begins within a short scroll; no default expanded provenance wall
minimum_visual_acceptance.related_desktop: candidate material precedes full manual grouping form
minimum_visual_acceptance.projects_mobile: selected project content or material action ahead of large folder/search panel
minimum_visual_acceptance.plan: title/priority/purpose and task action dominate; raw fields are secondary

artifact_review.comparison_rule: Use actual browser viewport screenshots only; arrange them side-by-side without changing UI pixels except proportional downscaling.
artifact_review.final_site_manifest: record actual value after central build
